newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB makes Peter Ellwood chief exec.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB makes Peter Ellwood chief exec.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc said on Friday Peter Ellwood would become chief executive effective February 7, replacing Sir Brian Pitman, who will become chairman.
Pitman will succeed Sir Robin Ibbs, the current chairman, who will retire.
Lloyds TSB said Alan Moore would continue as deputy group chief executive.
Moore is expected to retire at the end of 1997, Lloyds TSB said in a statement.
Ellwood was group chief executive of TSB Group from 1992 until its merger with Lloyds Bank in December 1995.
He has been deputy chief executive of the merged group and chief executive of retail financial services since then.
